name: The Robber Bridegroom
source:
Amanda's hand has been promised to an unsettling man who keeps asking her to visit him in his house deep in the forest.

She goes. Whether she comes back or not depends on you.

[From [url=https://radicalhoodie.itch.io/the-robber-bridegroom]itch.io[/url]]
